Better options out there
Aug 2019 • Solo
Hokkaido had a nice feel for it considering it’s in a shopping mall. Menu looked and sounded pretty good. Service was terrible. The girls that worked there could care less about you. They focused on one table of European tourists and everyone else didn’t bother until the check. I didn’t get my silverware or my bottle of water about 20 mins after I ordered. Obviously the food took forever and the appetizer came out after the ramen. Food was ok not bad not great. She also told me credit card is accepted. But when I asked for the check and gave her my card she made this disappointed face or annoyed. Came back with a portable CC machine and acted like it won’t work. I just gave her cash because I didn’t want to waste my time there anymore than I did. Had the girls who don’t know anything about service other than seeing $$$ it wasn’t too bad. Price is good so the food is pretty acceptable. But having that kindof service or lack of just totally turns you off. Rather go to a street vendor which is dirt cheap and not worry about service. You get your food fast and cheap. It’s becoming more apparent countries like Vietnam and Thailand could care less about your experience and service there. They just want your money. Enough tourists come through so who cares about repeat customers.

Sushi Delight
Jan 2019 • Couples
Tucked away in a corner of Nah Trang shopping center on the 3rd floor,this place serves a delight. For our last meal at Nah Trang we had gone there for lunch. My wife ordered a seafood ramen and I got myself a beef rice. Both were so full of flavor and delicious. But wait the sushi is yet to arrive. The crab sushi roll blew our minds off. It was just too good, probably one of the best sushi I have tasted in Vietnam.Wanted to order another round of sushi but then was too full already.Even the watermelon slices which was on the house at the end was very fresh and sweet. Would definitely come back if I’m in Nah Trang anytime soon.
